records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:10 — update` looks up the host by id without a nil check before calling `save_host`, which immediately calls `.host=` and raises NoMethodError for a bad/stale id instead of returning 404.
records.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` immediately does `host.host = ...` and `host.category_id = ...`, which will raise `NoMethodError` if no record is found for the given/stale `params[:id]` instead of returning a 404/appropriate error.

records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:60 — The `delete` action's `destroyRecord()` call has no `.catch`, so a failed delete is silently swallowed with no user feedback, unlike `save` which handles errors.
records.rationale: In the new component `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but does not attach a `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()` which uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). If the delete request fails, the rejection is unhandled and the user gets no error feedback, resulting in silently failed deletes.

records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6:22 — type.replace('_', '-')` lacks the `/g` flag, so admin model types with more than one underscore won't be fully dasherized before the `ADMIN_MODELS` lookup.
records.rationale: The diff changes `basePath` to check `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-'))`, which only replaces the first underscore. While the admin model types added/used in this diff (`embeddable_host` and likely `site_customization`) only contain a single underscore and will work, the implementation is not a full dasherization and would mis-handle any admin model type containing multiple underscores
